notes: Defined 5 stories for Manifest Snapshot Freshness covering schema, core logic, API, integration, and tests.

change_log.value: Added schema/contract story for manifest snapshot metadata
Added freshness evaluation engine logic story
Added API exposure story for freshness status
Added integration with manifest generation workflow
Added unit and integration tests for freshness behavior

stories.title: Define Manifest Snapshot Freshness Schema and Metadata Contract
stories.description: Define schema for manifest snapshot metadata including generation timestamp, source hash, and freshness TTL required for evaluation prior to execution.

stories.title: Implement Manifest Freshness Evaluation Engine
stories.description: Implement logic to evaluate whether a manifest snapshot is fresh based on TTL, last generation timestamp, and file hash consistency before allowing execution.

stories.title: Expose Manifest Freshness Status via Internal API
stories.description: Provide internal API or service method to retrieve manifest freshness status (fresh, stale, requires regeneration) for use by execution pipelines.

stories.title: Integrate Freshness Check into Execution Workflow
stories.description: Integrate freshness validation into dev pipeline and Brain runner execution flow to ensure manifest is validated or regenerated before use.

stories.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Manifest Freshness Enforcement
stories.description: Create tests validating freshness evaluation logic, stale detection, regeneration triggers, and enforcement in execution workflows.

per_feature.mitigation: Default to regeneration when freshness cannot be confidently determined.
